Date: 2026-10-17T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: ACTION: Pinegrove production P1 — request immediate geo-redirect (us-west2 AZ2 impact)

Team — Pinegrove (large customer) is seeing a sustained tail-latency and 500 spike originating in us-west2 AZ2. Customer impact: reduced throughput (~-60%), elevated 95/99th latency, and user timeouts. Logs indicate kv-cache saturation and repeated cold KVs on a subset of model shards. Attached: pinegrove_error_log_1017.txt, screenshot_500s.png.

Proposed mitigation (short-term):
- Divert 80% of Pinegrove production traffic from us-west2 -> us-west1 immediately (roll to 95% if metrics stabilize in 10 min).
- Flush prefix/KV cache for Pinegrove at the target region and pre-warm the top 20 prefixes.
- Keep circuit-breaker thresholds lower for 30 min; enable verbose tracing for the customer to capture any residual failures.

Authorization needed from Marissa for customer credit and from Hannah for exec notification. Aditya — can infra execute the geo-redirect and confirm when routing change is effective? I’ll communicate next steps to ANITA.

Runbook: https://redwood-internal.example.com/runbooks/geo-redirect
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/PG-7890

Sergio

Anita / Tom — thanks for your patience this morning. Quick summary of what we did and next steps: 

What happened:
- Brief production degradation in us-west2 (AZ2) causing elevated 5xx and tail latency for Pinegrove starting ~08:55 PT.

What we did (mitigation):
- Executed a staged geo-redirect (80% -> us-west1) at 10:11 PT, flushed and pre-warmed KV cache, and increased tracing.
- Within 10 minutes error rate dropped from ~7.8% to under 1% and p95 latency normalized near baseline.

Customer credit:
- As discussed, we will issue a credit for the impacted window (today 08:55-10:15 PT). Marissa approved up to $10k; I’ll confirm exact amount once we finalize the timeline.

Next steps / RCA timeline:
- Infra team will produce a preliminary RCA within 24 hours and a full postmortem in 72 hours. We will include telemetry, configuration diffs, and suggested mitigations (e.g., shard-level KV caps and more aggressive pre-warming).
- We will schedule a 30-min technical sync with your platform team tomorrow to review the RCA and validate routing settings (proposed slot: 10:00 PT).
